nom: Toner Pads - with Centella Asiatica Extract and Collagen

segments.dry: One reviewer reports a good moisturizing effect on her dry skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin consistently report no irritation, with hydrated, refreshed and soothed skin after use.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report hydrated, refreshed, softer skin after use, but one reviewer says it isn't deeply hydrating and doesn't leave her skin looking glowy or dewy, and another noticed no real difference from her regular toner.
concerns.redness: Reports are mixed: one reviewer says the pads helped ease redness and stinging from cold-weather irritation, while another reports it did nothing for the redness on her face.
concerns.spots: One reviewer bought the pads specifically for dark spots from hyperpigmentation and sun exposure but remains unsure whether they helped after limited use, while others report a gradually brighter, more even complexion over time.

aspects.libelle: Pads are generously saturated and large enough for face and neck
Included tweezers allow mess-free, hygienic application
Doubles as a quick targeted mask, not just a swipe toner
Widely seen as overpriced compared to regular toners

extraits.titre: Exfoliating pads with collagen that hydrate; jury's still out on dark spot improvement
extraits.texte: I purchased Snidin Toner Pads - with Centella Asiatica Extract and Collagen to help combat the dark spots that have unfortunately popped up on my skin over the years thanks to hyperpigmentation and sun exposure. I have tried nearly every product under the sun to lessen their appearance, from high end creams to prescription treatments and everything in between. I didn't really have high hopes for these pads as I have been disappointed by many such products in the past. These pads come with a handy set of plastic tweezers that fit conveniently in the top of the jar. Pulling out a single pad was easy, and the pad was moist but not sopping wet. It is textured on one side, which helps exfoliate the skin slightly. I rubbed all over my face, leaving behind the asiatica extract and collagen, which dried quickly and didn't leave my skin feeling taut. Whether or not it actually helps reduce dark spots remains to be seen, however. As with any such product, I think it would take months of continuous use before I would see any improvement, so I remain skeptical, but hopeful. I like the option to use a pad as a mask instead, which I think would deliver better treatment over the long run, so I will use that method going forward. I did not have any redness or irritation from using them, and my skin felt softer and smoother as well as being more hydrated afterward. That being said, for the price point, which is fairly high, I am not certain these pads are better/different than any other toner

extraits.titre: Not bad, but not seeing any good results from it either.
extraits.texte: I’m actually shocked at how expensive these toner pads are. While I think they’re decent, they certainly aren’t anything remarkable. They come in a container with little tweezers, which makes it easier to grab one out. I like that the round pads are heavily saturated. They didn’t really have a scent that I noticed. I like that there’s one side that’s textured with bumps and one side that’s flat. I like using the textured side as I feel that gets into my skin better. This is not at all astringent like a lot of other toners I’ve used. It’s very light and refreshing. My skin soaks it up pretty quickly so while it is hydrating, I certainly wouldn’t classify it as deeply hydrating as my skin does not look glowy or dewy after using it. It does not help any of the redness on my face either. I definitely don’t think this is a bad product, but I’m honestly not really noticing anything different with it and certainly nothing worth the expensive price tag.

I have been using regular astringent toner in general from various brands but this items are truly great where it's very moisturizing and it comes with pads soaking with all the essence, instead of using additional cotton pad. The toner pad feels refreshing and gel likes feeling while being applied on, but doesn't feel slimy at all. In additional, I can use one pad for the whole face and even neck. It can be used like a partial facial mask by applying it on both cheek and forehead, but I think it's a bit wasteful. The price is a bit steep for 70 pads compared to many other brands, which is why I minus the 1 star. Otherwise, the toner pad suits well and give a good moisturizing effect to my dry skin.

I don't use toners a lot, but I do have a couple I swear by. I prefer non-astringent toners that soothe and moisturize my skin instead of tightening pores and reducing oil. This one sounded perfect for my needs and it even has CICA, one of my favorite soothing skincare ingredients, as well as collagen. The toner pads come in a pop-open tub with a pair of plastic tweezers in the lid so that you don't need to stick your hands in the jar and are able to grab just one pad easily. These are nice sized pads (almost the size of the palm of my hand) and are very saturated in toner. They have a mild smell that I associate with CICA products, but nothing major. Each pad was more than enough to cover my whole face, neck, and décolletage, with product leftover. On application, they feel a little bit slimy (but only slightly) and very wet. The toner itself left my face with a very faint tackiness while it was wet, but there was no noticeable leftover stickiness once my skin had absorbed the product. I was honestly very pleasantly surprised. My skin was left feeling soothed, soft and plumped and looked great! I've been having some issues with flaking and some irritation around my nose from the cold winter weather and these not only felt soothing, but actually helped ease the redness and stinging. I'm glad I took a chance on these!

extraits.titre: Good ingredients. Hydrating, refreshing, soothing. Serum on pads absorbs well/no residue. Pricey.
extraits.texte: These toner pads are infused with a serum composed of an impressive collection of ingredients that promote hydration, barrier repair, soothing, and brightening of the skin. The pads are thin, and are textured on one side. While each pad is coated in the serum, the pad is not drenched in serum like some other toner pads I have used. The instructions provide that you can use these as a regular toner, or apply them to specific areas for several minutes as more of a quick mask. I have used the pads both ways. My sensitive skin after use felt more hydrated, refreshed, and soothed, and it looked a bit brighter. The moisture from the pads absorbs quickly with no sticky residue left on the skin, which is something I appreciate. While the ingredients in the serum are good, they are not particularly unique. Based on my experience trying many toners, most higher quality toners contain the same ingredients as these pads. I point this out only because the current $38 sale price on these is, in my opinion, a little crazy considering this is not a well-established brand. Of the many toner pads I have tried, many of which I preferred to these pads, none was remotely close to these in price. The price is the reason I give these four stars rather than five. I would purchase them in the future but only if they were substantially discounted.

I chose this snidin product because I saw it was viral on TikTok. I thought it would be fun to try! I'm actually really happy with the results. My skin feels smoother. I have experienced zero irritation from this, and my skin is somewhat sensitive so this is worth noting. It's a pleasant feeling to slide these toner pads over your face. I have noticed my pores appear smaller as well. There were two safety seals which always makes me feel more confident using a product. There are also cute little tweezers built into the tub. This is great so you're not contaminating the rest of the contents, and it just feels like a nice touch. These are an enjoyable part of my skincare routine. I'm very pleased with how well these are working for my skin. Good quality, and worth trying. Would recommend, these are exceeding my expectations.

extraits.titre: Brighter, Smoother Skin in One Easy Step!Brighter, Smoother Skin in One Easy Step!
extraits.texte: I absolutely love the Snidin Toner Pads! They’ve quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. The pads are super gentle but still do an amazing job of removing leftover dirt, oil, and makeup after cleansing. My skin always feels refreshed, smooth, and hydrated after using them. One of my favorite things about them is how versatile they are. Not only can you swipe them across your face like a normal toner pad, but you can also place a few of them on areas like your cheeks, forehead, or chin and leave them on for a few minutes like a mini face mask. It’s such an easy way to give your skin extra hydration and calming care when it needs it. They don’t irritate my skin at all, and I’ve noticed my complexion looking brighter and more even since I started using them. My face feels clean and refreshed without that tight, dry feeling. If you’re looking for something convenient, gentle, and multi-purpose for your skincare routine, I highly recommend these toner pad.
